overrides.comment: Atmosphere (Tier 3) + self-hosted @font-face — raw hex permitted (art-directed editorial constants / fonts). The generated Tier 1 primitives file is excluded from linting via top-level ignoreFiles (machine-generated; regenerate via vp run primitives:gen, never hand-edit). The Tier 2 semantic file (index.css) is NOT exempt — it is hex-banned.
